baseline_static_findings.finding: background_cycle calls service.predict() when the next target has no freeze. Existing worker is not a status-only boot check; startup metadata explicitly says autostart_registered=False.
Legacy DLT freezes/replays tables have primary/unique keys but no database UPDATE/DELETE triggers; SSQ protects freeze UPDATE/DELETE and some other UPDATEs, not a universal append-only ledger.
Legacy DLT NetClient permits HTTPS redirects to another host. sources._validate_response only rejects non-HTTPS final URLs; SSQ sources._response_url explicitly verifies original host.
SourceReceipt has fetched_at, not authenticated official publication time. Neither legacy domain contract provides independent 01/04 or external TSA qualification.
The pinned research scorer is a new research-only interface. Existing product eight-slot/model identity and original V4.0 contracts are not established by its synthetic model registry.
